label: Innovation Sandbox & DLT Pilot Application
description: Prepare a regulatory-sandbox, innovation-hub, or DLT Pilot Regime application under Regulation (EU) 2022/858. Covers eligibility, application content, test parameters and limits, investor-protection and safeguarding terms, exit strategy, and structured regulator engagement.

claudeKnowledge.description: DLT Pilot Regime Regulation (EU) 2022/858, ESMA DLT Pilot Regime guidance and exemption-request templates, MiCA (EU) 2023/1114, MiFID II / MiFIR, CSDR (EU) 909/2014, national NCA sandbox / innovation-hub guidance (BaFin, AMF, Finansinspektionen, FIN-FSA, CBI, MFSA), EFIF and EBA/ESMA/EIOPA innovation-facilitator reports

guidedInputs.label: Facility / Regime Sought
guidedInputs.description: Which innovation pathway are you applying to? This determines the legal basis, the NCA process, and what exemptions are even available.

options.label: DLT Pilot — DLT Multilateral Trading Facility (DLT MTF), Art. 8
DLT Pilot — DLT Settlement System (DLT SS), Art. 9
DLT Pilot — DLT Trading & Settlement System (DLT TSS), Art. 10
National regulatory sandbox (live testing, restricted authorisation)
Not yet determined — help me choose the right pathway

guidedInputs.label: Competent Authority (NCA)
guidedInputs.description: Which member state's NCA will receive the application? The DLT Pilot Regime is operated by national NCAs with ESMA coordination.

guidedInputs.label: Applicant Authorisation Status
guidedInputs.description: What authorisations does the applicant already hold? This decides whether you need a parallel MiFID II / CSDR authorisation alongside the DLT permission.

options.label: New entrant — no existing investment-firm / CSD authorisation
Authorised investment firm / market operator (MiFID II)
MiCA-authorised CASP / EMT or ART issuer

guidedInputs.label: Application Sections to Prioritise
guidedInputs.description: Which parts of the application package need the most work right now?

options.label: DLT functioning, IT & cyber resilience (DORA interface)
Safeguarding of participants' funds, collateral & assets
Test parameters, monitoring & reporting to the NCA

guidedInputs.label: Known Concerns, Constraints or Pre-Application Feedback
guidedInputs.description: Describe any known weaknesses, hard constraints, or feedback already received from the NCA or ESMA. Absence of a clear exit strategy or a compensatory-measure for each exemption is the most common rejection driver — flag what you have and have not yet addressed.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. NCA pre-application feedback questioned our delivery-versus-payment model on a permissionless ledger; we have no exit plan if we breach the EUR 6bn aggregate market-value cap; settlement finality under Settlement Finality Directive is unresolved for our self-hosted-wallet participants.

exampleInput: We are a Swedish fintech (12 staff, not yet authorised) preparing a DLT Pilot Regime application to Finansinspektionen for a DLT Trading and Settlement System (DLT TSS) under Article 10 of Regulation (EU) 2022/858. We want to admit tokenised SME shares and a small tokenised bond programme, settled on a permissioned ledger with an e-money-token cash leg. Because a TSS draws its exemptions from Article 6 (which applies Articles 4 and 5 mutatis mutandis), we plan to request the Article 5 / Article 6 exemptions from the CSDR book-entry and settlement-finality requirements (CSDR Arts. 3, 39 and 40) so retail participants can hold DLT financial instruments directly via self-hosted wallets, plus the MiFID II intermediation exemption (via Article 4 / Article 6) so they can be direct members of the venue without a mandatory investment-firm intermediary. Draft the application content, set defensible test parameters against the Article 3 caps, design the compensatory measures for each requested exemption, and build a credible Article 7(7) exit/transition strategy if we breach a cap or the NCA withdraws the permission. Known weak spots: settlement finality for self-hosted-wallet holders is unresolved, and we have not yet sized our aggregate market value against the EUR 6 billion threshold (or our action plan at the EUR 9 billion transition ceiling).

exampleValues.known_concerns: Requesting the Art. 5/Art. 6 CSDR book-entry exemption (direct holding via self-hosted wallets) and the Art. 4/Art. 6 MiFID II intermediation exemption (direct venue membership), but compensatory measures are not yet drafted. Settlement finality under the Settlement Finality Directive is unresolved for self-hosted-wallet holders. Aggregate market value not yet sized against the EUR 6bn cap — no Art. 7(7) exit/transition plan if the EUR 9bn ceiling is breached.
